data.one_liner: A flutter_map plugin that enables the use of vector tiles.
data.what_it_does: Loads vector tiles from sources like Mapbox or Stadia Maps and renders them as a layer on top of a flutter_map instance. It supports themes, sprites, custom tile providers, and alternate file formats through community packages.
use_when: You are using flutter_map and need to render vector tiles instead of raster tiles
You want custom styling or dynamic themes for your maps from providers like Mapbox or Stadia Maps
avoid_when: You prefer standard raster tile layers without vector styling features
strengths: Supports multiple popular map styles and providers
Improves performance by rendering vector tiles to raster images or maintaining layer modes
weaknesses: Requires careful matching of themes and tile providers
May require attribution depending on the tile data provider used
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the dependency and configuring a StyleReader with your API key along with a VectorTileLayer in your FlutterMap children.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need standard raster tile mapping rather than vector tiles.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer native Google Maps instead of flutter_map and vector tiles.
